nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Shared pytest fixtures and fakes for the test suite: fake Zalo client, fake Gemini agent, a mocked web API server, and factories for Settings, Bot and incoming webhook events.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses httpx.MockTransport to intercept the web API client and monkeypatches environment/config so tests never touch real machine settings.

nodes.name: FakeZalo
nodes.summary: In-memory Zalo client double that records sent messages, can fail a configurable number of times to exercise retry logic, and exposes sent texts per chat.

nodes.name: FakeAgent
nodes.summary: Fake AI agent recording reply and classify calls; returns canned reply text and a configurable filter verdict or error to drive message-filter scenarios.

nodes.name: FakeWeb
nodes.summary: Fake web backend (/api/agent/*) served through an httpx handler; checks bearer key, records calls, and answers from a route table with optional offline mode.

nodes.name: make_settings
nodes.summary: Builds a Settings object from an isolated env dict rooted in tmp_path, with rate limits and budget disabled and per-test overrides.

nodes.name: event
nodes.summary: Builds a Zalo bot webhook payload (message.text.received by default) with auto-incrementing message ids and configurable sender, chat and timestamp.

nodes.name: make_bot
nodes.summary: Pytest fixture returning a factory that constructs a Bot wired to the fake Zalo and agent with zero retry delay.

nodes.name: web
nodes.summary: Pytest fixture that installs FakeWeb as the httpx transport, points config at tmp_path and sets schedule API env vars.

nodes.name: test_bot.py
nodes.summary: Async tests for the Bot message handler covering access control, trigger modes, owner commands, dedupe, restart persistence, splitting, rate limits, budget, ordering, leader/role commands and tool context.

nodes.name: send
nodes.summary: Test helper that feeds a payload to the bot and drains its processing queue.

nodes.name: test_desktop.py
nodes.summary: Tests for desktop packaging concerns: app home resolution (source, frozen, fallback), hidden subprocess windows, first-run setup, admin token, tool discovery, graceful gateway stop, logging, free port, autostart registry and secret scanning.

nodes.name: test_filter.py
nodes.summary: Tests for MessageFilter rules (trigger, tag, name, chatter, non-text) versus AI classification, plus Gemini classify behavior including JSON requests, token counting, timeout retry and thinking fallback.

nodes.name: msg
nodes.summary: Builds an incoming message via to_incoming with optional mentions, group flag and non-text content.

nodes.name: test_memorydata.py
nodes.summary: Tests for per-chat memory logging: every message is logged while only passed ones reach the session, unallowed chats are skipped, the store trims, and the read-chat-memory tool is scoped to its own chat.

nodes.name: test_personal.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the personal-account Zalo client: session loading, incoming mapping, thread type selection, error wrapping, listener dispatch, network error detection and mention/tag building and name learning.

nodes.name: FakeApi
nodes.summary: Fake zlapi client used to capture sent messages and simulate results or errors for PersonalZalo tests.

nodes.name: test_remote_config.py
nodes.summary: Tests for remote config and web sync: whitelisting allowed keys, live apply and restart persistence, heartbeat fetch with network tolerance, session uploader batching, bot chain recording and link-code handling.
